name: Breadcrumb Navigation
purpose: Represent contextual location within a real product hierarchy and return to valid ancestors without replacing Global Navigation or Product Navigation.
problem: Prevent invented hierarchy, undocumented route derivation, clickable Current, and use as primary navigation.

observed: Breadcrumbs component set 1122:153: Divider Slash/Chevron; Type Text, Text with line, Button, Account dropdowns; Desktop/Mobile; internal _Breadcrumb button base; Current=True/False; Default/Hover/Focused.
Observed composition equivalent to Home / Settings / ... / Team, with Team Current=True.
Breadcrumbs contract observes Dropdown menu/account breadcrumb, Avatar, Radio and icons; dimensions are not tokens or breakpoints.
approvedAuroraDecisions: Breadcrumbs represent existing information architecture and journey context, never invented hierarchy.
Compactation retains Current, Nearest Ancestor and Root before Intermediate Ancestors.
... represents real omitted ancestors and opens a temporary surface without changing the compacted composition.
Available space drives adaptation; numeric breakpoints are not defined.
Keyboard operation and visible focus are required; technical HTML and ARIA remain open.

compositionRules: Root is the first relevant contextual level and is Home only when Home is the real root.
Ancestors are navigable only when a valid destination exists.
Exactly one Current uses Current=True semantically and does not navigate.
Do not set an arbitrary maximum hierarchy depth.
Compact Intermediate Ancestors before Root, Nearest Ancestor or Current.
Opening ... reveals omitted ancestors in a temporary surface without altering current compactation.
Reuse existing Aurora Dropdown/Menu composition when applicable; do not create a dedicated new component when an existing composition satisfies the need.

behavior.collapsedHierarchy: keyboard-accessible interactive control revealing real omitted ancestors; valid destinations remain navigable
behavior.accountDropdowns: existing visual composition; switching, permissions, selected semantics and context switching undocumented and outside Pattern v0

responsive.rule: Adapt to available space and compact before removing relevant context.

constraints: Do not replace Global Navigation or Product Navigation.
Do not invent numeric breakpoints, hierarchy limits, route mapping, or Account dropdown behavior.
Do not choose Type or Divider by visual preference.
Do not duplicate visual details owned by components/breadcrumbs.
antiPatterns: Choose Chevron as more modern or Button as better on mobile.
Add account selector only because it exists in component set.

must: Navigate ancestors only with valid destinations.
Prioritize Current, Nearest Ancestor and Root.
Use ... only for real omitted ancestors.
Provide keyboard equivalence and visible focus.
should: Prefer full hierarchy when space permits.
Preserve established product Type and Divider.
mustNot: Derive Breadcrumbs from URL/routes without documented rule.
Invent maximum levels or numeric breakpoints.
